message:
As Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, the 1-tonne store only works as counted crates with staged intake, Manager.

In plain words many farmers share one cold box by paying per crate and bringing a quarter of the tonne each day so the sun can keep up, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer. The precedent in The Solution – ColdHubs (E43) places clean plastic crates on shelves under a pay-as-you-store daily flat fee per crate, so I use 50 crates at 20.0 kg each for 1000 kg total, staged as 250 kg per day with First-In-First-Out (FIFO, oldest crates sold first) paper tags in the revised steady load with 120mm PU and staged loading pull-down (E28), about 50 shopping bags of maize meal in everyday scale.

In plain words one person must carry each crate through one door in daylight without letting the cold out, Enclosure and Structural Designer. The guidance in Manual handling weight limits (E45) sets 20 kg close to the body at elbow height as the suggested adult limit, so 20.0 kg crates are one-person suitcase loads, handled through a single door with strip curtain under 8 openings per day discipline, stacked with 25 mm air gaps and narrow one-pallet-width rows for circulation stated in Small-Scale Postharvest Handling Practices (E44) inside interior volume cubic metres (E39) of 8.64 cubic metres, keeping the rear-to-front loop shown in Walk-in chamber: insulated box on ground pads, front door with strip curtain, two rack rows with vented crates, rear high evaporator airflow loop, roof PV shade frame (E42).

In plain words the cooperative can afford soap, paper and repair but not electronics, Solar Energy Systems Engineer. The rule in Small-Scale Postharvest Handling Practices (E44) keeps temperate crops near 0 degC but chilling-sensitive crops at 10 degC to 12 degC to avoid injury, so the single 5.0 degC mixed holding is an agreed compromise to hold tomatoes with leafy vegetables, paid by the flat fee in The Solution – ColdHubs (E43) covering reusable crates, twice-daily wall thermometer checks and hose cleaning with early-morning shaded intake.

I am not ready because we must agree the single 5 degC mixed setpoint and the 8-openings daytime attendant role before the box is locked.
